## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 0% | 2.2% | not applicable | 0% |

Thin national record: the Constitution is held with its 2001, 2008 and 2019 revisions and matches the Gazette word for word, but none of the main codes (Civil, Penal, Civil Procedure, Criminal Procedure) is in the tree, and only 120 of about 5,338 numbered laws since 1975 are held (mostly 2019-2026, as published, 49 with later amendments applied). The rest of the 689 'acts' are 503 presidential decrees (2010-2026, single versions) and 65 Athens municipal decisions; no case law is held.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
